_instructions: Copy this file (e.g. to config.json), fill in your own values, and point Kipp at the copy. Never edit this template directly.

icp_profiles._instructions: One entry per ICP profile you classify inbound records into.

profiles.label: [e.g. 'Government contractor, 10-200 employees']
qualifying_signals: [Signal or field that qualifies a record for this profile]

routing_flags._instructions: What happens to a record once it's classified into a profile above.

intake_sources._instructions: Every queue Kipp sweeps for new records, and how often.

enrichment._instructions: Kipp's contact/company enrichment provider and key.
enrichment.api_key_env_var: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the key itself here]
enrichment.deep_enrichment_provider: [optional, e.g. Clay -- only for profiles marked enrichment_tier: deep]

audit._instructions: Used by the periodic audit step in crm-intake/workflow.md.

database._instructions: Wherever you keep CRM records -- Notion, Airtable, a spreadsheet.
database.signal_inbox_db_id: [YOUR SIGNAL/INTELLIGENCE INBOX DB ID, IF YOU SWEEP ONE]

notifications._instructions: Where Kipp reports run summaries and exceptions.
notifications.webhook_url_env: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the URL itself here]
